listing.title: My First Pets Coloring Book
listing.subtitle: 30 Big & Easy Pets and Pet Things – Puppy, Kitten, Bunny, Fish Bowl & More for Kids Ages 2-5
listing.author: JONNY COLOR
listing.description_html:
Big, bold and easy to color: a first coloring book full of friendly pets!

Little hands color 30 cute pages of pets and the things they love, from a puppy with a collar and a kitten to a hamster, a fish bowl, a dog house and a ball of yarn. Every page has one big, simple picture with extra-thick lines, so small hands can color inside the lines, and each picture's name is written in big letters to color too.

Inside you'll find:

  • Furry friends: Puppy, Kitten, Bunny, Hamster, Guinea Pig, Spotty Dog, Sleepy Cat and Pony
  • Feathered, scaly and shelled pets: Budgie, Tortoise, Lizard, Hermit Crab, Snake and Fish Bowl
  • Pets at home: Bath Time, Kitten in a Box, Dog House, Birdcage and Best Friends
  • Pet things: Bone, Food Bowl, Collar, Ball of Yarn, Toy Mouse, Pet Bed, Hamster Wheel, Scratching Post, Pet Carrier, Paw Print and Treat Jar
  • One large picture per page with thick outlines
  • Single-sided pages with a blank back, so markers won't bleed onto the next picture
  • Big 8.5 x 11 inch pages and a "Great job!" certificate at the end

A fun, screen-free activity for toddlers and preschoolers ages 2 to 5.

Part of the my first step series.
